question: Should `socket.drain` be an advisory hint recovered by authoritative resynchronization after reconnect, or a reliably replayable teardown event?
rationale: The current Gateway transport cannot guarantee delivery to a slow subscriber: it closes the socket and targeted events have no replay sequence, so implementation details depend on the intended client contract.

options.title: Advisory with resync
options.body: Document missed-event behavior, require clients to resubscribe and reload session state after reconnect, and test the overflow recovery path.

options.title: Reliable replay or acknowledgement
options.body: Design a sequenced replay, acknowledgement, or durable state-transition mechanism before exposing the event as deterministic delivery.

recommendation.title: Advisory with resync
recommendation.body: Document missed-event behavior, require clients to resubscribe and reload session state after reconnect, and test the overflow recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person directly to the shared session lifecycle broadcast and its test contract.
